adapter_obligations.rule: Every rank must be present in the actual supplied evidence count/list.
Ranks must be exact integer tokens, not bool/float/exponent/string; existing adapter rule unchanged.
Ranks must be unique and strictly ascending; never sort or deduplicate.
Map only to the exact supplied policy_id/version/section_id; preserve ask and decision fields; no lookup/retrieval.
Preserve frozen V2/V1 parser consistency and status/reference pairing without decision repair.
Construct only the existing frozen GateOutput after all validation and adapter checks pass.

parse_boundary_note: EXACT_VALIDATOR_ENFORCED here means the mandatory parse-plus-exact-validator pipeline. A JSON Schema validator alone does not parse bytes or detect duplicate keys.
